Product
Product overview
  • Aqua

    Use Generative AI to accelerate your workflows securely.
  • Compute Capsules

    Encapsulate code, data, environment, and generated results.
  • Pipelines

    Connect, automate, parallelize, and scale computational work.
  • Data

    Manage all data in the cloud, and from other sources, in a single place.
  • Models

    A unified environment for ML models with native MLflow integration.
  • Lineage Graph

    An automated, immutable record of result data provenance.
  • Collections

    Gather and organize computational work to make it visible and findable.
  • Apps

    Use ready-made bioinformatics Apps, or quickly build your own.
  • Admin Panel

    A single pane of glass to manage all users, resources, and data.
  • API

    Enable programmatic access without using the user interface.

Careers

We’re building the future of Computational Science

Join a thriving team working at the intersection of science, technology, and advanced data science—and make a difference to the future of scientific discovery.

Supporting scientists around the world

Code Ocean is headquartered in midtown Manhattan NY with an office in Tel Aviv and remote staff throughout the US and Canada. Our team is composed of talented individuals with research, tech, and business backgrounds who are passionate about our mission to accelerate Computational Science.
